src:
flowchart TD Q{captureAuthorizer는 누구인가} -->|페이실리테이터 자신| D[delegated] Q -->|운영자 컨트랙트| C[custom] Q -->|정책 컨트랙트를 읽는 운영자| P[policy
예약됨, 미배포] D -->|receiverAuthorizer 없음| D0[authorize만 중계
이후는 대역 밖] D -->|receiverAuthorizer 있음| D1[전체 생명주기 중계
서명 검사는 페이실리테이터만] C --> C1[collect만 중계
capture/void/refund는 운영자 SDK로] P --> P1[서명과 잔액 스냅샷을
온체인에서 검사]

sequenceDiagram participant A as 에이전트 participant M as 판매자 서버 participant CB as Coinbase
(x402_url, 운영자) participant E as AuthCaptureEscrow
(Base) M->>CB: 체크아웃 생성 CB-->>M: x402_url A->>CB: POST x402_url CB-->>A: 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED
(scheme auth-capture) A->>A: ERC-3009 서명
(nonce = 결제 조건 해시) A->>CB: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE CB->>E: authorize CB-->>A: 200 (승인됨, 아직 정산 아님) CB->>E: capture (수 초 내) CB-->>M: 웹훅, 상태 COMPLETED Note over M,CB: 환불은 판매자의 Coinbase
USDC 잔액에서, 비동기

flowchart TD Q{Who is captureAuthorizer} -->|the facilitator itself| D[delegated] Q -->|an operator contract| C[custom] Q -->|an operator that consults a policy| P[policy
reserved, not deployed] D -->|no receiverAuthorizer| D0[relays authorize only
lifecycle out of band] D -->|with receiverAuthorizer| D1[relays full lifecycle
only the facilitator checks signatures] C --> C1[relays collect only
capture/void/refund via operator SDK] P --> P1[signatures and balance snapshots
checked onchain]

sequenceDiagram participant A as Agent participant M as Merchant server participant CB as Coinbase
(x402_url, operator) participant E as AuthCaptureEscrow
(Base) M->>CB: create checkout CB-->>M: x402_url A->>CB: POST x402_url CB-->>A: 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED
(scheme auth-capture) A->>A: sign ERC-3009
(nonce = payment-terms hash) A->>CB: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE CB->>E: authorize CB-->>A: 200 (authorized, not yet settled) CB->>E: capture (within seconds) CB-->>M: webhook, status COMPLETED Note over M,CB: refunds come from the merchant's
Coinbase USDC balance, asynchronously
